mechanism: Sacubitril enhances natriuretic peptide signaling causing vasodilation and reduced blood pressure, while zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte disturbances and acute kidney injury, increasing risk of hypotension and renal deterioration.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes, and blood pressure closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and assess risk-benefit in patients with baseline renal impairment.
